body:
Founder real-time (remote control): port BIG_O tech into SHANKPIT as first-class engine tech, not an app; BIG_O replaces SHANKPIT STORY. Landed and verified this pass: packages/simulation/day_night_clock.{h,c} + PARENA-generated world_rules.c (new PARENA/stdlib/shankpit domain), packages/render/sky_weather.{h,c}+cfg (ported from BIG_O's bigo_sky.h/bigo_skycfg.h, replacing retro_sky's fixed fast-orbit dome), and REFLUX becoming genuinely PARENA-powered (reflux_mod.c wired to the already-real reflux_host_* contract, ECOWAR's own proven precedent). make lobby/make server both build clean; day_night_clock (6 tests) and reflux_mod (6 tests) both pass. No LICENSE added to SHANKPIT per explicit founder instruction. Full phased plan for the rest (witness rules, humanness AI-brain, lab sim, pheromone commands, phone UI, MODE_STORY cutover) in docs2/specs/BIGO_ENGINE_MERGE_NORTHSTAR.md. Commits: SHANKPIT b126690, PARENA d360756, EMILY 4d85dbd2.

⚓ ☃
title: BIG_O engine merge phase 1: day/night+weather clock, weather-aware sky, PARENA-powered REFLUX
